items.title: pre-fight-input-guide
items.claim: The qualifier card shows STANCE and TECHNIQUE beneath directional chevrons, but omits the action guide visible in the fight frame.
items.reason: The introduction is a useful place to explain what each direction does before the player needs it.
items.suggest: Reuse the fight frame’s directional action guide on the qualifier card, with readable labels and no overlap with the Fight button.

items.title: record-clock-label
items.claim: The Asmongold win-result frame displays 29s on the round timer and FASTEST WIN 6.1S without identifying the record’s time basis.
items.reason: These values are not necessarily contradictory, but players cannot tell whether the record includes introductions or referee pauses.
items.suggest: Verify which clock supplies the record, then explicitly label it as elapsed time or fighting time; do not change either value based on this still.

items.title: result-pose-separation
items.claim: Both pictured win-result screens show the declared winner striking an opponent who remains in a fighting stance.
items.reason: At these captured moments, the character tableau still depicts contact rather than a distinct victory or defeat.
items.suggest: Retain the scoring pose for the impact moment, then use a distinct victory-and-defeat or bow tableau alongside the result panel; verify the existing transition before changing it.

items.title: desktop-keyboard-discovery
items.claim: The desktop fight frame displays two touch-stick controls but no visible keyboard bindings.
items.reason: A desktop player cannot discover the keyboard mapping from this screen.
items.suggest: Place a compact keyboard legend between the sticks, populated from the actual input bindings, while retaining the touch controls.

items.title: metadata-size-unverified
items.claim: The techniques sheet renders scoring metadata visibly smaller than move names, but the raster image cannot establish its computed CSS font size.
items.reason: Relative size alone does not prove a violation of the project’s 18 CSS px readability minimum.
items.suggest: Measure the metadata’s computed font size at the supplied phone viewport; increase any text below 18 CSS px and wrap the rows rather than shrinking their contents.
